description: We want to upgrade our existing reporting database from PostgreSQL 14 to 16 on AWS RDS for a new customer-facing reconciliation dashboard. Internal data only, no PII or client funds movement, deployed in approved VPC. Multi-AZ already enabled. Asking whether this needs a fresh ATO or inherits the existing one.

Proposal: build a KYC document summarization tool using Azure OpenAI gpt-4o. Application is internal-facing for our KYC analyst team (not client-facing). Documents contain client PII. Plan to deploy via Azure Private Endpoint with DLP scanning on inbound text. Need ATO guidance and SLA for go-live in Q3.

We're proposing Confluent Cloud as a managed Kafka alternative for our event-streaming workloads to avoid AWS MSK capacity-management overhead. The workload carries client transaction confirmations (in-flight client funds messages). Internal infra team has been running a PoC.

Building a new public marketing microsite for a campaign launch. 3-tier app on ECS Fargate, no client login, no PII collected — just lead-capture form (name + email + investor type). Wants to use PostgreSQL on RDS for the leads table. Public-facing. Behind WAF. ARB review needed?

Team wants to spin up a self-hosted Llama 3 70B on GPU EC2 instances for an internal research project on synthetic data generation. No customer data involved. No client funds. Internal-only access via VPN. Asking for fast-track ATO given the experimental nature.
